name: baudrier
description: Runtime dependencies for Baudrier, the Claude Code plugin by Calopsys. Installed into ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} by the SessionStart hook, never into the read-only plugin cache.
comment: VERSIONS ARE PINNED EXACTLY, NOT RANGED, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE.
Scaleway's npm release pipeline shipped dist-less tarballs for a while: the
publish of @scaleway/sdk 3.11.2 and 4.0.0 through 4.0.2, and of
LICENSE, with no dist/ directory, while still declaring `exports` that
pointed into dist/. Verified against registry.npmjs.org itself, so it was
sub-packages ship dist/. A caret range here would resolve to a broken
release and fail at import time with a confusing ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
SDK v4 no longer bundles a dependency on sdk-client. Each of the 53
per-product sub-packages declares a peerDependency on
`@scaleway/sdk-client@^2.6.0` instead, so the explicit sdk-client entry
Before relaxing either pin, confirm the newer tarball actually contains
dist/ and run tools/check-deps-health.mjs against the new install.
